concerns.text: FR-002 mandates executing a minimum of 10,000 time-steps per configuration. Task T016 is explicitly scoped to '1000 time-steps'. No task exists to implement the 10,000-step execution logic required by the spec.

FR-007 requires the system to 'adjust the model accordingly' if lag-1 autocorrelation exceeds 0.1. Task T021 only implements the computation and check (ACF < 0.1). There is no task to implement the model adjustment logic or fallback strategy.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 5 (T032) vs spec.md:SC-006 & plan.md:Constitution Principle VII
concerns.text: SC-006 and Constitution Principle VII require partial correlation analysis to ensure metric independence *before* applying parametric tests (LMM). Task T032 is placed in Phase 5 (US3), after the LMM analysis (T020) in Phase 4. No task exists to perform this check prior to the LMM.

Spec Edge Case 3 requires the system to flag results as 'Power-Limited' if the dataset is unavailable or generation fails. No task exists to implement this specific flagging logic or the fallback to a smaller synthetic dataset.

FR-005 requires calculating latency reduction against a 'throttled neural baseline'. Task T031 calculates the reduction but lacks an explicit dependency or linkage to the throttling logic implemented in T013, risking calculation against unthrottled data.
